job.title: E-Commerce Manager*in (m/w/x) - Shopify Plus, Klavijo & SAP Business One
job.email_subject: Application: E-Commerce Manager – shop operations and ERP integration
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your shop depends on a clean link between storefront, product data and ERP – I have run and integrated large online shops with ERP and PIM for 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell.

– Catalog, pricing, promotions and order management end to end
– ERP/PIM-to-shop data pipelines and integration troubleshooting
– Requirements, user stories and UAT with business teams; AI-assisted

I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. My CV and cover letter are attached. My profile combines technical depth with close work alongside business teams, and I would bring exactly this experience to your team. Could we schedule a short call in the coming days?

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan
https://www.linkedin.com/in/kranti-chavan-84a155191

tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Manager | Shop Operations, ERP Integration & Product Data
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce professional with 5+ years running and extending large B2B and B2C online shops for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Knows the shop end to end – product catalog, pricing, promotions and order management – and connects it with ERP and PIM systems through APIs and data pipelines. Analyses business requirements, writes user stories, coordinates international teams and external partners, supports UAT and production, and uses AI tools extensively in analysis and documentation.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: AMPELMANN turned an East Berlin traffic light into a beloved brand with its own shops and a strong online business. The role combines shop management, marketing and ERP integration – and my strength lies exactly in keeping storefront, product data and backend systems working together, which is what a growing brand shop needs.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I applied for E-Commerce Manager: 5+ years running and extending large online shops at Rockwell Automation and Shell – catalog, promotions, orders and ERP/PIM integration. Open to Berlin, start 16.12.2026. Happy to have a short chat!

en.subject: Application: E-Commerce Manager*in – Shopify Plus, Klaviyo & SAP Business One
en.hook: Your online shop only works as well as the connection between storefront, product data and ERP. That connection is where I have worked for more than five years: at Rockwell Automation and Shell I run and extend large online shops and integrate them with ERP and PIM systems – so that products, prices and orders are always right.

bullets.label: Shop operations end to end
bullets.text: Implemented and maintained product catalog, pricing, promotions and order management on large B2B and B2C platforms and supported production issues.

bullets.label: ERP & shop integration
bullets.text: Built data pipelines between PIM, ERP and the shop and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and PIM with international teams.

bullets.label: Storefront & product data
bullets.text: Customized storefronts with JavaScript, built headless APIs for PWA frontends and kept product catalogs synchronized across global channels.

bullets.label: Stakeholders & partners
bullets.text: Analysed requirements with business teams, wrote user stories and specifications, supported UAT and used AI tools to speed up analysis and documentation.

en.logistics: AMPELMANN is an iconic Berlin brand, and I would enjoy making its online shop as reliable and recognizable as the brand itself. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, am open to relocating to Berlin and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I look forward to a conversation.
